headline: PetroReconcavo Halts Gas Production in Bahia for Maintenance
summary: PetroReconcavo has suspended its natural gas production in Bahia to conduct maintenance operations scheduled to last 25 days and conclude by November 19, 2026.
why: Temporary production stoppages for maintenance reduce short-term output volumes for energy producers, impacting localized supply schedules.

impacts.name: PetroReconcavo
impacts.why: Temporary suspension of gas production halts output from these fields during the maintenance period.
